overview.description: The Global X HealthTech ETF (HEAL) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Global X HealthTech index. The fund tracks a narrow index of stocks globally, seeking to capture novel applications of AI technology and robotics focused on the healthcare industry. Companies selected must derive 50% of their revenue from one of the four subthemes HEAL was launched on Jul 29, 2020 and is issued by Global X.
